items.text: The Velocity Code™ / Multi-Sport Foundation Program

Produces measurably faster (+1 mph sprint speed), more explosive (+3 inches vertical jump), and genuinely confident youth athletes ages 8–12 — proven by calibrated technology (timing gates to 0.001 seconds, force plates, bar velocity trackers to 0.01 m/s), guaranteed by a written performance contract, and delivered through a four-principle proprietary training system: Effort (verified by technology and pre-session readiness assessment), Intensity (Velocity-Based Training in the individual power zone 0.7–1.0 m/s), Speed (set ends at 10% velocity drop, strict rest protocols), and Confidence (real-time velocity display, weekly velocity profiles, objective PR tracking). Not general conditioning. Not sport-specific drilling. The science of speed and power applied during the single highest-return developmental window in an athlete's career.
